scientific_integrity: Exact analytic all-order proof; finite numerical checks corroborative only; originality is a literature-comparison judgment with residual coverage risk.
scientific_limitations: Real-linear simultaneous extension on a regular Euclidean polygon with chord distances and all side midpoints; no claim about arbitrary polygons, complex-linear operators or nonlinear extensions. Previously evaluated square, pentagon and hexagon cases are included but not separately novel.
title: Universal sharp midpoint extension on every regular Euclidean polygon
